path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2018_10K_reconstructed.json'
obj=json.load(open(path))
for i,t in enumerate(obj.get('texts',[])[:20]):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if 'shares' in txt.lower() or 'common stock' in txt.lower():
        print(i, t.get('page_no'), txt[:300])

item.text: The fast text tools aren’t available here, so I’m switching to a direct shell read of the JSON and looking for the cover-page line in plain text.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2018_10K_reconstructed.json'
obj=json.load(open(path))
for i,t in enumerate(obj.get('texts',[])):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if 'shares of common stock' in txt.lower() or ('common stock' in txt.lower() and 'outstanding' in txt.lower()):
        print('INDEX', i)
        print('PAGE', t.get('page_no'))
        print(txt)
        print('---')
PY"
